svg.title: MCP under the hood: the 2026-07-28 changes and the authorization timeline
svg.text: Wire: JSON-RPC 2.0 · transports: stdio (local) and Streamable HTTP (remote)
No sessions or Mcp-Session-Id; every request
The server returns input_required; the client
State that must survive between calls is a
List results carry a time-to-live and a cache
Long-running tasks move to an extension;
AUTHORIZATION, BUILT UP FROM OAUTH STANDARDS
